verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a remote-access product, since alternatives in this category can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of a self-hosted or on-premises TeamViewer server. MSI mass deployment covers client rollout, which is an adjacent feature, and one community user is explicitly looking for a self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
